lens: Weinberg proof integrity and Klein disconfirmation

findings.summary: The refusal continuation command silently drops evidence-led mode.
evidence: skills/public/debug/scripts/debug_artifact_state.py:135-139 emits only --subject, even when scaffold.evidence_mode is true.
An in-memory probe of the bound command builders emitted '--subject existing-report' without --evidence-led. The ordinary scaffold-command control preserved --evidence-led.
The bound planner CLI parsed the emitted continuation with evidence_mode=false. Passing that value to the bound render_template omitted Evidence Disposition; adding --evidence-led restored it.
plan_debug_run.py and scaffold_debug_artifact.py propagate that false value into validator command construction, dropping mandatory evidence-led validation on this continuation route.
findings.action: Preserve the applicable evidence-led mode in the emitted refusal continuation command. Add a regression that consumes the printed command and checks the resulting scaffold and validator flags.

findings.summary: The revised diagnosis workflow permits commitment without executing the competing-cause discriminator.
evidence: skills/public/debug/SKILL.md:114-125 requires recording an observation that would distinguish competing causes, followed by testing one hypothesis; it does not require obtaining the distinguishing result.

A timeout investigation can list increased server latency and a lowered client timeout, record a latency/configuration comparison without running it, then raise the timeout and observe success. That test supports both explanations, yet the workflow proceeds to recording a root cause.

references/five-steps.md repeats the recording obligation. tests/test_debug_artifact.py accepts two candidate bullets with one disconfirmer; those structural checks cannot establish that competing explanations were distinguished.
findings.action: Require executing the discriminating check and recording its result before choosing among live alternatives; otherwise retain an unresolved diagnosis. Exercise this through a first-reader scenario, without adding a certificate or marker validator.
